role: training and development comparison only; no new independent localization evidence
design: same 29 training FD records, seed 42, 5 Hz frozen eikonal and velocity, 5000 receiver-only updates plus 1000 physics/receiver updates; new training from scratch; only alteration is smooth differentiable source-dependent onset gate
evaluation: compare frozen baseline raw and baseline postprocessed with freshly trained gate, at true sources on the 12 already-used depth development events; unshifted full and active waveform L2, finite depth response, false early picks and paired pick RMSE; no retuning
decision: a reduced false-pick count alone is insufficient; require reduced FD-active L2 and acceptable finite depth response before specifying fresh held-out source localization
